mentions.name: AutotradeLab
mentions.description: Asset management service that uses automated and AI-driven trading for portfolio diversification and higher returns, offered as trading results as a service. Its philosophy is capital protection first: protecting capital and managing risk while trading, since avoiding large losses enables compounding and high long-run returns. Rather than taking over an investor's whole portfolio, it positions itself as one component of a diversified portfolio alongside index funds and bonds. Initial allocations will open in the near term, with founding investors (the first clients) offered a portfolio review aligned to long-term goals and a direct line to founders. The service draws on the co-founder's three decades of experience in trading and finance.
mentions.audience: Investors seeking higher returns through portfolio diversification; its first clients are called founding investors and receive perks like a portfolio review and a direct line to founders.
